ValidationRule.description: Checks whether subcategory has been specified whenever the category is selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case" , NOT ISPICKVAL (IME_SC_Category__c , "" ) , ISPICKVAL(IME_SC_Sub_Category__c , "" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sub Category cannot be blank once Category is selected.
